calibrated_on: restacks.xlsx: 506 cases with price+level (269 older, 129 Feb-Jun 2026, 108 Jul-Nov 2026). Base prices = Jul-Nov 2026 level; effects of level/height/codes/hub fitted on all cases (robust regression). Checked on 10 CS feedback orders.
formula: point = group.base + level.add + hub.add + height.add + codes.add; low = point - range.minus; high = point + (level.range_plus or range.plus); recommended = point; all rounded to nearest $5

range.note: Level L4 uses range_plus from its level entry: only 6 Difficult+ cases in the base, prices spread $100-$250, the supervisor confirms the final number.

hubs.note: Core hubs are the reference. Other hubs (Reno, Fontana, Fremont, Portland, Flowery Branch, East Brunswick, Wood Dale, Detroit, Greensboro, O'Hare ...) price about +$7 higher in the model fit.

levels.name: Easy
levels.visual: Load is still on its pallet. Light shift or lean, wrap loose or torn. Nothing (or a few cases) on the floor. Fix = push back / re-wrap / re-band.

levels.name: Medium
levels.visual: Stack clearly leaning or partly collapsed; part of the cases fell, but packaging is mostly intact and product stays in its boxes/bags. Fix = rebuild part of the pallet by hand.

levels.name: Difficult
levels.visual: Pallet collapsed; many cases on the floor, boxes crushed or open, layers mixed. Full manual rebuild of the pallet, some sorting, new pallet or corner boards likely.

levels.name: Difficult+
levels.visual: Loose units out of their packaging (cans, bottles, produce, insulation), spillage or smashed product, re-boxing/re-packing needed, heavy units needing special handling. Supervisor informed.

list.name: Displacement
list.desc: Load shifted partially or fully off pallet

list.name: Spillage

list.name: Missing Pallet
list.desc: Pallet missing or broken, needs replacing

weight.note: No price effect found in the data (residual ≈ $0 per bucket, 156 cases with weight). Kept as info for the hub (equipment). Set 'add' if management wants a weight surcharge as policy.

escalation.message_supervisor: Supervisor approval required before confirming the job

time.formula: per_pallet = level.time + codes_counted * codes.time_per_code + group.time_add; total = per_pallet * pallets
time.source: Labor effort column, 184 cases: Easy median 20 min, Medium 40, Difficult 60, Difficult+ 150 (only 5 cases)
